title: Prince Harry and Meghan to relocate to UK this month, enrol kids in British schools: Report
content:
• Prince Harry and Meghan are reportedly planning to relocate from the US to a private residence outside London later this month, with their children, Prince Archie (7) and Princess Lilibet (5), enrolled in British schools.
• King Charles III has clarified that there will be no change to Prince Harry and Meghan's role as private individuals and non-working members of the royal family.
• Prince Harry established the Invictus Games, a Paralympic-style sporting competition for injured servicemembers and veterans, over a decade ago.

title: Petrol and diesel prices today — 20 Aug: Latest fuel rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru as Trump targets Iran’s economy
content:
• On 20 August, global benchmark Brent crude traded below $92 a barrel and West Texas Intermediate for October stood near $84, after crude oil gained more than 5% over the last four sessions.
• US President Donald Trump announced a fresh package of economic measures against Iran, shifting the strategy from military options to 'Economic Warfare and Isolation' and warning other sovereign states of 'tremendous economic consequences' for aiding Iran's financial institutions.
• The Strait of Hormuz is a critical trade route through which one-fifth of global oil and natural gas is traded.

title: Trump ally Mike Lindell refuses to concede defeat in Minnesota governor primary, says he will fund a full recount
content:
• A full recount of the Minnesota governor and lieutenant governor races would cost approximately $825,000.
• Mike Lindell has until Monday, 24 August, to submit the recount request and payment to the Secretary of State’s office.
• Minnesota's threshold for an automatic state-funded recount is 0.25% of the vote margin.

title: Aditya Birla Group and the six-year chase for a key RBI label
content:
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) defines a Core Investment Company (CIC) as a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC) with at least 90% of its assets in group companies' shares/bonds/loans, and at least 60% of its investments in equity shares. From August 2020, the number of CIC layers within a group, including the parent, was capped at two, with compliance required by end-March 2023.
• Birla Group Holdings Pvt. Ltd (BGHPL) was granted Core Investment Company (CIC) registration by the Reserve Bank of India on 18 November 2025, after first applying in September 2019.
• A Core Investment Company (CIC) is subject to a public listing requirement if its assets exceed ₹1 trillion (₹1,00,000 crore).

title: US Set to Cut Tariffs on Canada Metals, Autos in Trade Deal
content:
• The tentative US-Canada trade deal proposes lowering tariffs on certain Canadian steel and aluminum exports from the current 50% to 25%.
• The agreement aims to cut duties on Canadian auto exports, specifically on non-US content, from 25% to 15%.
• US President Donald Trump announced a three-day pause on Tuesday evening for planned 50% levies on Canadian goods, aiming to finalize a broader deal before a Friday deadline.

title: India’s  ₹1 trillion RDI fund to select next set of fund managers in a ‘couple of weeks’
content:
• India's Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) fund, launched by the government, has an outlay of ₹1 trillion.
• As of July 23, Union Minister of State for Science Jitendra Singh reported that the Technology Development Board (TDB) issued ₹2,192 crore to 22 startups, and the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (Birac) issued ₹390.35 crore to eight startups under the RDI fund.
• The RDI scheme was notified by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on November 3, and eligible startups must meet a minimum Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of 4.

title: ‘Mera baap kaun hai’: Omar Abdullah says Gen Z goodwill is at stake, reacts to viral video
content:
• The incident involving a protesting Gen Z tourist occurred at the Minimarg checkpoint in Kargil, Ladakh.
• The event took place on 25 July, leading to temporary traffic restrictions for the movement of the Defence Minister and Army Chief along the Zojila-Gumri route.
• Omar Abdullah, the former Jammu and Kashmir chief minister, reacted to the viral video featuring the Gen Z protest.

title: RBI MPC puts Q3 rate hike in play if inflation risks show up big
content:
• The RBI Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) kept the policy rate unchanged at 5.25% at its meeting held between August 3 and 5.
• RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta projected inflation to peak as high as 5.9% in Q3 2026-27, which may necessitate a hike during the year.
• Headline inflation rose to 4.4% in June and 4.5% in July after remaining within the 4% target for 16 months.

title: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra flags inflation risks; says rate recalibration needs greater clarity, MPC Minutes show
content:
• The six-member Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) voted in its August 2026 meeting to keep the benchmark repo rate unchanged for the fourth consecutive time.
• RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that greater clarity on the inflation trajectory is needed before any recalibration of the policy rate.
• Governor Malhotra flagged the possibility of policy tightening if emerging price risks begin to broaden or affect inflation expectations.
